findings.issue: PharmacySwitcher stores selection but doesn't filter any view - selectedPharmacyId is persisted to localStorage but no component reads it to filter API calls or UI
findings.suggestion: Either wire it to backend endpoints that accept pharmacy_id parameter, or add UI indicator that it's non-functional until backend support is added

findings.issue: Password field in StaffForm uses unconditional autocomplete="new-password" even in edit mode when the field is optional
findings.suggestion: Use conditional autocomplete: autoComplete={f.id ? "off" : "new-password"} to prevent browser password save prompts on edit forms

findings.issue: StaffForm allows assigning pharmacy to owner role - pharmacy assignment dropdown renders even when role could be 'owner', but owners should not be assigned to specific pharmacies in multi-pharmacy setup
findings.suggestion: Disable or hide the pharmacy assignment dropdown when f.role === 'owner', or show helper text explaining owners are not pharmacy-specific

findings.issue: PharmacyContext missing fallback for undefined user - logs warning but continues with isSystemOwner=false and empty pharmacyList, making it impossible to distinguish initialization failure from non-system-owner
findings.suggestion: Add loading or error state to the context return value to allow consumers to handle initialization failure explicitly
